messages:
maria-partnerlead: Quick sync — we need a cleaner handshake for SI co-sell handoffs across EMEA/APAC. Too many mid-deal surprises.
alex-sales: 100%. we've had 3 accounts this quarter with duplicate outreach. can we codify territory carve + lead ownership?
jordan-si-eng: If we set a firm territory map + a 48h response SLA for initial intro, that should cut overlap.
kevin-ps: Also we need to be explicit about when SI owns the lead vs when Redwood drives the sale. Current ambiguity kills pipeline velocity.
tara-ops: proposal: "Handshake Protocol v1" — short checklist + single-source lead record in SFDC with tag `SI_HANDSHAKE`.
ian-gtm-bizdev: +1. let's keep rules simple:
- SI has primary ownership when they originated the opportunity and contributed >=30% of pipeline value OR when customer requests SI engagement.
- Redwood retains ownership if we introduced the account and SI is brought in as a technical partner.
maria-partnerlead: Also add revenue thresholds: above $150k ARR -> joint-owner model (both get credit); below -> developer-friendly referral credit. helps sales comp alignment.
alex-sales: can we avoid hard thresholds that block smaller strategic accounts? suggest an opt-in override with manager approval.
jordan-si-eng: fine. override flow:
1) Sales files an override in SFDC `SI_OVERRIDE` with short rationale.
2) Partner team reviews within 48h.
3) If approved, mark `SI_HANDSHAKE: OVERRIDE_APPROVED` and route.
kevin-ps: routing detail — map by account HQ region first, then by technographic fit. put a simple CSV as single source of truth in Drive and sync nightly to SFDC.
tara-ops: agreed. I'll create the Drive sheet. columns: `account`, `region`, `primary_owner`, `si_partner`, `technical_fit`, `handshake_status`, `last_update`.
ian-gtm-bizdev: example row for clarity:
```
acme-corp, EMEA, alex-sales, infraSI, high, handshake_sent, 2026-03-18
```
maria-partnerlead: for handoff email template (to use when introducing SI):
"Hi <Customer>, copying <SI lead> and <Redwood AE>. We propose a joint call to validate architecture and commercial fit. Suggested times: ..." Keep it short.
alex-sales: can pipeline-bot automatically create SFDC task when handshake_sent? reduces manual steps.
pipeline-bot: yes — I can create tasks when Drive row status flips to `handshake_sent`. assign to `primary_owner`.
jordan-si-eng: escalation/contest process when both SI and Redwood claim ownership:
- raise thread in #partnerships with `@maria-partnerlead @ian-gtm-bizdev`.
- 72h decision window.
- if unresolved, escalate to VP sales / VP partnerships for final assignment.
kevin-ps: one more piece — blackout windows for direct Redwood outreach after SI intro. propose 7 days quiet period unless SI agrees to joint outreach.
maria-partnerlead: 7 days seems fair. add exception: urgent legal/compliance requests (security reviews) can break silence.
tara-ops: operational checklist for handoff:
1) SFDC lead tag set
2) Drive row updated
3) Intro email sent with meeting scheduled
4) Brief partner play doc attached (1 pager)
5) Pipeline-bot task created
I'll own the checklist implementation.
alex-sales: owners and SLAs — can we record in one-pager? also need to train AEs this week.
ian-gtm-bizdev: i'll run 30 min training tomorrow 10am PT. agenda: rules + demo of Drive->SFDC sync + override flow.
maria-partnerlead: action items:
- tara: create Drive sheet + sync (due EOD today)
- pipeline-bot: enable task creation (ETA 24h)
- ian: run training (tomorrow)
- jordan: update partner play 1-pager (include intro template & tech fit checklist) (due 3/21)
alex-sales: I'll circulate a short FAQ to the sales pod after training.
maria-partnerlead: thanks all. if anyone has edge cases (global SI with cross-region conflicts), drop them here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
pipeline-bot: task created: "Implement Drive->SFDC handshake sync" assigned to tara-ops, due 1768498740.
